compareTo: test ordering, same value, different values, compare to null (should throw NullPointerException), compare to non-ValuedEnum (ClassCastException). Since compareTo casts to ValuedEnum, passing other type (e.g., String) should cause ClassCastException.

toString: ensure format includes short class name, name, value; also caching behavior (calling twice returns same string). Also test that ClassUtils.getShortClassName works; but rely on library. We'll just verify string pattern.

But ValuedEnum.getEnum is protected static, so subclass can expose public static method.

We'll implement:

public static SampleEnum getEnum(int value) { return (SampleEnum) ValuedEnum.getEnum(SampleEnum.class, value); }

Then test.

- testToString()

But test class can be in same package? The test file is likely in same package to access protected? Protected static is accessible within same package. Since we don't know package, we can put test in same package org.apache.commons.lang.enums. We'll declare package accordingly. Then we can call ValuedEnum.getEnum directly.

Thus test file will start with package org.apache.commons.lang.enums;
